steps._comment_pre_submit_js: DRY RUNS ONLY. walk.py refuses to run this on a commit run: it strips `disabled` off EVERY button on the page, and VFS disables Continue to say there is nothing to book. It exists so a mapping run can reach the later pages and capture their DOM. A commit run hitting the no-slots banner stops there instead — see NO_SLOTS_PATTERNS in src/booking/walk.py.
